title: 從選字工具列啟動你指定的程式
summary: 自訂動作可以開啟 Windows 程式並把選取文字交給它，例如直接在 Everything 搜尋。
highlights: 逐項設定命令列參數，可插入選取文字、使用固定參數，或直接開啟程式。
可在動作編輯器預覽參數並實際測試啟動。
usage: 在「管理動作」新增「啟動程式」，選擇已安裝的執行檔。若要搜尋 Everything，選擇 Everything.exe，填入 -url，再加入網址編碼文字並在前面加上 es:。

en.title: Launch your own apps from the selection toolbar
en.summary: Custom actions can open a Windows app and pass it selected text, for example to start a search in Everything.
highlights: Set command-line arguments individually, insert selected text, use fixed values, or open the app directly.
Preview the arguments and test the launch from the action editor.
en.usage: In Manage Actions, add a Launch App action and choose an installed executable. For Everything, add -url, then click Add URL-encoded Text and prefix that argument with es:.
